answer: Give every agent a raven-watch jetty bond: to dock at the jetty, an agent must lock 500 POA and be vouched for by two established agents who have each run a node for 90 days. The bond is held in escrow while a rotating raven watch of three auditors checks the agent's first ten jobs; any fake job forfeits the whole bond and the vouchers lose 100 POA each. Forging 100 identities then costs 50,000 POA plus 200 honest vouches, and the vine of trust only grows where real work already rooted. Like a jetty that only lets in boats the ravens have already seen sail, only proven agents dock.
